say:1:1620117001:1.text: How did it go? Have you found the troublemaker?
say:1:1620117001:1.source_cn: 调查的如何，找到那个四处作乱、扰人安宁的犯人了吗？

say:2:1620117002:1.text: We have! The troublemaker is actually... a cat spirit!
say:2:1620117002:1.source_cn: 主人已经找到了！犯人……其实是一只小猫灵！
say:2:1620117002:1.male: We have! The troublemaker is actually... a cat spirit!
say:2:1620117002:1.female: We have! The troublemaker is actually... a cat spirit!

narration:3:1620117003:1.text: Chippy explains how you arrived at your conclusion and describes the cat spirit's characteristics...
narration:3:1620117003:1.male: Chippy explains how you arrived at your conclusion and describes the cat spirit's characteristics...
narration:3:1620117003:1.female: Chippy explains how you arrived at your conclusion and describes the cat spirit's characteristics...

narration:4:1620117004:1.text: For some reason, Anathyme falls silent after hearing that.

say:6:1620117006:1.text: I see. But to confirm your findings, I have to take a look at that cat spirit myself.
say:6:1620117006:1.source_cn: 我明白了。不过，为了验证你们的说法，我需要亲自看一眼那...

say:7:1620117007:0.text: It's certainly a necessary step. After all, the culprit is an extraordinary one...
say:7:1620117007:0.source_cn: 唔，确实需要证明一下呢。毕竟这位“犯人”的真实身份……...

say:8:1620117008:1.text: But the cat seems terrified of you, seeing how it vanishes the instant you show up. How can we make sure you see it?
say:8:1620117008:1.source_cn: 只是小猫灵好像很怕亚娜奇卡教授，一看见她就会消失。怎么...

say:11:1620117009:1.text: Why don't we catch some fish to use as bait?
say:11:1620117009:1.source_cn: 要不然，钓点鱼当诱饵吧！

say:12:1620117010:1.text: The cat's been sneaking bites off meat and canned fish, so it'll probably go for some fresh fish too! While it's enjoying our bait, you can quietly step out, Professor... Hee-hee, that should do the trick!
say:12:1620117010:1.source_cn: 那只小猫灵偷吃了鲜肉和鱼罐头，说不定会被鲜鱼吸引。趁它...

say:13:1620117011:0.text: Good idea, Witstaff! Your magic might be unreliable, but you're clever in other ways!
say:13:1620117011:0.source_cn: 好主意！维茨瓦夫的魔法虽然不太靠谱，但这种奇怪的点子倒...

say:14:1620117012:0.text: You can drop the part about my magic!

say:15:1620117013:1.text: *Cough*... Magister, let's go <style="highlight">catch some fish</style> for the cat spirit!
say:15:1620117013:1.male: *Cough*... Magister, let's go <style="highlight">catch some fish</style> for the cat spirit!
say:15:1620117013:1.female: *Cough*... Magister, let's go <style="highlight">catch some fish</style> for the cat spirit!
